verdict.rationale: Ultrametric installs skill files into projects via `ultrametric init`, which writes .agents/skills and .claude/skills SKILL.md files and supports a dry-run preview, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a command to list installed skills or to uninstall them cleanly. `doctor` reports only the CLI version, API origin and local file locations, and no remove, uninstall or cleanup path is shown for skill files or injected instructions.
